text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
The joint dorm Christmas party――a modest, 
enjoyable gathering held every year.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Decorating the common area, preparing 
treats, and planning recreational 
activities. 
Our duty is to bring everyone a peaceful 
and modest moment of relaxation――"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Now then, we shall begin the Christmas 
party planning meeting! 
Our headquarters will be right here in the 
Miho Dorm lobby, so assemble every night!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"First, please review the handout before 
you! 
It is a proposal drafted using previous 
years' Christmas parties as reference."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"What do we have here~? Pour juice and 
make a toast. Chat and mingle 
while eating snacks together. Play 
recreational board games..."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Uggghhh, that's as bland as a plain rice 
ball with no filling! 
At least throw in some popping candy! Fire 
off a bazooka!!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Gah! Open flames are strictly prohibited 
here! 
If you take your fooling around too far, I 
will drag you to the staff room 
immediately!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Providing a peaceful, relaxing Christmas 
party for all participants 
is our duty. Violating public order and 
morals is strictly taboo!!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hmph. How utterly devoid of elegance.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"At any rate, shall we try thinking along 
the lines of this proposal for now? 
We will definitely need to divide up 
roles, after all... As for the opening 
toast――"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"I shall handle it. 
Since a King is hosting, nothing less 
would be appropriate."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
! Are you sure you can handle that? Even 
arranging the drinks...? 
I-I see. Then I leave it in your hands.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
What shall we do about the snacks? We have 
the budget to consider... 
We'll need to get creative. Perhaps... 
handmade treats?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh... yeah. Leave that part to me. 
I'll whip up a few things, you'll see.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Then there's recreation, huh. 
Guess I've got no choice. Golshi-chan, the 
incarnation of entertainment, will cook up 
something special.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
In that case, may we leave decorating the 
venue to you, Meno-san? 
I will handle all the other miscellaneous 
tasks.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(All four of them seem surprisingly 
cooperative... 
To think this meeting would proceed so 
smoothly...)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(I can't let my guard down, but... the 
five of us are the management committee. 
I want us to work together properly to 
make this a wonderful Christmas party.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all for your cooperation, sir! 
It is a huge help that you are being so 
proactive.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Please make sure to keep me updated on 
your progress without fail. 
Let us all give our very best to our 
assigned duties!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (System Monologue)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
All right. I'm glad we had plenty of 
origami and tissue paper, sir! 
I must thank the Student Council for their 
help――――?!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Fireworks?!?! At this distance... that's 
on school grounds! 
Who would do something so extravagant――!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
What do you think you're doing, sir?! 
Orfe-san!!!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: A test launch. Magnificent, is it not?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
What?! What complete nonsense are you 
saying! Doing this without permission―― 
What about fire regulations, paperwork, 
and costs?! Aaaaargh...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
That was the work of licensed 
professionals; fire safety is no concern. 
―I am presiding over the opening. Thus, it 
must kick off with a grand, spectacular 
bang.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
WHAT I ENTRUSTED TO YOU WAS JUST TO 
PROPOSE A TOAST, SIR!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(Yesterday, even I ended up getting called 
into the guidance office after that... 
Good grief, and they promised to cooperate 
properly, too――)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
―*sniff sniff*... This is... the scent of 
foul play... 
No, I physically smell something?! Spices, 
and something sweet...?!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Is it in here?! Breaching the room――!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
――!! …………?!?!?  
...W-What in the world are you doing, 
sir...?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, just test-baking some pastries for the 
Christmas party. 
The first batch just came out of the oven. 
Want a taste?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ah... that's right, you were in charge of 
the snacks... 
My apologies. I suspected you without 
thinking.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Oh, these are mini cream puffs. 
They look absolutely delicious, sir! Well 
then, if you'll excuse me, I shall have a 
taste――

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Picking the "winner" on your first 
try? You've got quite the luck, Meno!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Russian Roulette Cream Puffs."  
The winning one is packed with 
agony-inducing super spicy habanero paste. 
Gives ya a real thrill, don't it?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
SLIPPING IN HAZARDOUS SUBSTANCES IS AN 
OUTRIGHT CRIME!! 
THESE ARE CONFISCATED, SIR!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, what is wrong with them! Don't 
tell me they're actively trying to ruin 
the Christmas party...! 
――――Hm? What's that...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heave-ho, heave-ho! Heave-ho, heave-ho! 
Ooooh heave, heave-ho-ho!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Golshi-san? What are you―― 
WHAT IN THE WORLD ARE YOU DIGGING, SIR?!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ain't it obvious? 
It's the stage for the Pitfall Prank 
Comeback Championship.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
What kind of extremely dangerous 
championship is that?! 
Digging holes on campus without permission 
is also a violation――

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
HOLD IT RIGHT THERE! YOU'RE UNDER ARREST, 
SIR――!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Your shovel is confiscated, and you are 
going to fill that hole right back up, 
understand?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Tch~~ And the stage was just about done, 
too~. 
Did your tracking stats go up or 
something? Did you equip jet engines?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. It seems you let yourself get a bit 
carried away, Golshi-san. 
Though it is quite an eccentric proposal 
for recreational activities...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh, I'd kinda like to stand on that stage 
though. Falling into a pitfall, with the 
added risk of bombing your reaction on top 
of it.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama-san, that goes for you too! And 
for Orfe-san as well!! 
School rule violations, poison tampering, 
dangerous games...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Are you all deliberately trying to ruin 
the Christmas party?! 
I need you to take this more seriously and 
prepare according to the original plan, 
sir!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
How dull. Your ideas are far too 
uninspired.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Your personal amusement is not the 
standard here, sir!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh, honestly... Journey-senpai is the 
only one taking things seriously... At 
this rate, we'll never...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I get where you're coming from, Meno. But 
ain't you being a bit too one-sided? 
We're part of the "management committee" 
too. We got our own philosophy.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If our opinions are clashin' this hard, 
guess there's no help for it. 
How 'bout we settle this... right here, 
once and for all?
